subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: After the final rebase, is direct Codex contract review plus completed affected-workflow evidence sufficient to approve these executable action revisions in credential-bearing jobs?
rationale: The revisions have clean official-release provenance and no line-level defect, but approval spans GitHub App keys, registry tokens, API credentials, code-scanning uploads, and agent execution.

options.title: Approve After Full Gates

options.title: Split Codex Action
options.body: Land the other official action bumps separately and review openai/codex-action v1.11 with a narrower contract and rollback boundary.
